name: Chana Ros
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight, drain and simmer in fresh water for 45–55 minutes until tender. Reserve the cooking liquid.
Toast coconut, coriander seeds and dried chillies until fragrant and lightly brown; blend with ginger, garlic, turmeric and a little chickpea liquid into a smooth paste.
Cook onion in oil until golden, then add tomato and cook until soft. Stir in the coconut paste and fry it for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Add chickpeas, tamarind, salt and enough cooking liquid for a flowing ros; simmer 12 minutes. Serve hot with warm pav.
tips: Roast coconut gently; dark burnt coconut makes the ros bitter.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
